Name: DAD 422 ITU 7.1 target layout for IEM AllRADecoder
Description: Seven ear-level mains at the targets in the Week 7 room-calibration lesson. Channel 4 is reserved for LFE and is not decoded. Import this layout into AllRADecoder and calculate a first-order decoder. Verify physical routing with the plugin's Noise buttons before monitoring.

LoudspeakerLayout.Name: ITU 0+7+0 target angles; 7.1 channel slots
LoudspeakerLayout.Description: Azimuth is positive left. Channels: 1 FL, 2 FR, 3 C, 4 LFE (unused), 5 SL, 6 SR, 7 RL, 8 RR. Zenith and nadir are imaginary triangulation points, not outputs.
